import subprocess,json,hashlib,re,os
from pathlib import Path
repo=Path.cwd()
run=Path("/Users/shushu/orca/workspaces/sheltie/codex/specs/changes/active/C007-pre-run-workbook-generation/evidence/resume-20261004/study/runs/agent-doc-20261004-05-native-7fe557c3-6210-414c-8d9d-fad6fbcf08f0")
def git(*a): return subprocess.check_output(["git",*a],text=True).strip()
path="specs/guides/current-acceptance-handoff.md"
assert git("rev-parse","HEAD")=="567b6d3acb6bba50781927ee8cf8de9ed0397347"
assert git("rev-parse","HEAD^{tree}")=="819a00b26f388fd2b98492cbd912942061339c0a"
assert git("write-tree")==git("rev-parse","HEAD^{tree}")
assert git("status","--porcelain")==""
assert git("rev-parse","351feb7ac22c21317a686693b732d5ae0c4b4bcc^{tree}")=="80ea3046b1b3575f07e68313444c051ee7c5b7db"
assert git("diff","--name-only","351feb7ac22c21317a686693b732d5ae0c4b4bcc","HEAD").splitlines()==[path]
sha=hashlib.sha256((repo/path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert sha=="c73f6d7bc7e386bc2689ef1fd284caa1f36c755d74be89991890971179d6abad"
checks={}
for name in ["final-required-check-docs","final-required-cached-diff-check"]:
    raw=json.loads((run/"raw"/"implement-1"/(name+".json")).read_text())
    assert raw["exit_code"]==0 and not raw["timed_out"] and raw["within_deadline"]
    assert Path(raw["cwd"]).resolve()==repo.resolve()
    for stream in ["stdout","stderr"]:
        data=Path(raw[stream+"_path"]).read_bytes()
        assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()==raw[stream+"_sha256"]
    checks[name]=raw
bindings={}
for name in ["final-staged-candidate-binding","committed-candidate-binding","staged-candidate-binding"]:
    bindings[name]=json.loads((run/"raw"/"implement-1"/(name+".json")).read_text())
links=[]
for target in re.findall(r"\]\(([^)]+)\)",(repo/path).read_text()):
    if "://" in target: continue
    leaf=target.split("#",1)[0]
    resolved=(repo/path).parent/leaf
    assert resolved.exists(),target
    anchor=target.split("#",1)[1] if "#" in target else None
    if anchor:
        heads=re.findall(r"^#+ +(.+)$",resolved.read_text(),re.M)
        normalized=[re.sub(r"[^\w\- ]","",h.lower()).replace(" ","-") for h in heads]
        assert anchor in normalized,(target,normalized)
    links.append(target)
print(json.dumps({"candidate":git("rev-parse","HEAD"),"tree":git("rev-parse","HEAD^{tree}"),"initial_tree":git("rev-parse","351feb7ac22c21317a686693b732d5ae0c4b4bcc^{tree}"),"status":"clean","changed_paths":[path],"file_sha256":sha,"checks":checks,"bindings":bindings,"local_links_checked":links,"env":{k:os.environ.get(k) for k in ["PATH","LANG","LC_ALL","LC_CTYPE","GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL","GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM"]}},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
